cues.en: EventBridge Rule with event pattern, a rule matches that incoming events and sends them to targets for processing.
cues.zh: EventBridge Rule with event pattern：規則會比對傳入事件，並將它們傳送到目標處理。

cues.en: You also have EventBridge Scheduled rule that will invoke a target at a scheduled time.
cues.zh: 還有 EventBridge Scheduled rule，會在排定的時間叫用目標。

cues.en: EventBridge Pipe connects an event source to a target with optimal filtering and enrichment.
cues.zh: EventBridge Pipe 會連接事件來源與目標，並提供篩選與擴充。

cues.en: EventBridge Schedule, that will invoke a target one time or at regular intervals defined by a cron or rate expression.
cues.zh: EventBridge Schedule 可依 cron 或 rate 運算式，單次或定期叫用目標。

cues.en: And finally, EventBridge Schema registries collect and organize schemas.
cues.zh: 最後，EventBridge Schema registries 可收集與整理結構描述。
